static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(message); }
var project = typeof(NativeSessionAgentFactory).Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeApprovalAgent")!.GetMethod("Project", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)!;
AgentResponseUpdate Project(AgentResponseUpdate source, IList<AIContent> contents) => (AgentResponseUpdate)project.Invoke(null, [source, contents])!;
static (AgentResponseUpdate Outer, ChatResponseUpdate Raw, FunctionCallContent Call) Source()
{
    var call = new FunctionCallContent("front", "frontend", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["city"] = "Paris" });
    var native = new ToolApprovalRequestContent("ficc_front", call) { RequiresConfirmation = false };
    var raw = new ChatResponseUpdate(ChatRole.Assistant, [native, new TextContent("preserved"), new FunctionResultContent("earlier", "actual")]) { ResponseId = "response", MessageId = "parent", AuthorName = "native", CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch, FinishReason = ChatFinishReason.ToolCalls, ModelId = "model" };
    return (new AgentResponseUpdate(raw) { AgentId = "agent" }, raw, call);
}
var source = Source();
var beforeOuter = JsonSerializer.Serialize(source.Outer); var beforeRaw = JsonSerializer.Serialize(source.Raw);
var expected = new List<AIContent> { source.Call, source.Raw.Contents[1], source.Raw.Contents[2] };

var result = Project(source.Outer, expected);

Check(!ReferenceEquals(result, source.Outer) && result.Contents.SequenceEqual(expected) && !ReferenceEquals(result.Contents, source.Outer.Contents), "Public contents must be owned by a new outer update.");
Check(result.RawRepresentation is ChatResponseUpdate rawResult && !ReferenceEquals(rawResult, source.Raw) && rawResult.Contents.SequenceEqual(expected) && !ReferenceEquals(rawResult.Contents, source.Raw.Contents) && rawResult.ModelId == "model", "Pinned raw projection must independently clone and synchronize its contents while preserving raw-only properties.");
Check(JsonSerializer.Serialize(source.Outer) == beforeOuter && JsonSerializer.Serialize(source.Raw) == beforeRaw && source.Raw.Contents[0] is ToolApprovalRequestContent { RequiresConfirmation: false }, "Original inner update, raw representation, contents and native request must remain unchanged.");
Check(result.AuthorName == source.Outer.AuthorName && result.AgentId == source.Outer.AgentId && result.ResponseId == source.Outer.ResponseId && result.MessageId == source.Outer.MessageId && result.CreatedAt == source.Outer.CreatedAt && result.FinishReason == source.Outer.FinishReason && result.ContinuationToken == source.Outer.ContinuationToken, "Every supported outer property must survive projection.");
foreach (var mutation in new[] { "unknown", "contents", "role", "parent", "response", "finish", "author", "created", "continuation" })
{
    var subject = Source();
    if (mutation == "unknown") subject.Outer.RawRepresentation = new object();
    if (mutation == "contents") subject.Raw.Contents = [new TextContent("foreign"), subject.Raw.Contents[1], subject.Raw.Contents[2]];
    if (mutation == "role") subject.Raw.Role = ChatRole.Tool;
    if (mutation == "parent") subject.Raw.MessageId = "foreign";
    if (mutation == "response") subject.Raw.ResponseId = "foreign";
    if (mutation == "finish") subject.Raw.FinishReason = ChatFinishReason.Stop;
    if (mutation == "author") subject.Raw.AuthorName = "foreign";
    if (mutation == "created") subject.Raw.CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch.AddSeconds(1);
    if (mutation == "continuation") subject.Raw.ContinuationToken = ResponseContinuationToken.FromBytes(new byte[] { 1 });
    var rejected = false;

    try { Project(subject.Outer, [subject.Call]); }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { rejected = true; }

    Check(rejected, "Unknown or inconsistent native raw update must fail representability: " + mutation);
}
var publicBoundary = typeof(NativeSessionAgentFactory).Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeApprovalAgent")!.GetMethod("ProjectForPublic", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)!;
foreach (var mutation in new[] { "valid", "unknown", "contents", "role" })
{
    var call = new FunctionCallContent("owned-echo", "backend", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["code"] = "original" }) { InformationalOnly = true };
    var raw = new ChatResponseUpdate(ChatRole.Assistant, [call]) { MessageId = "native-echo-parent", ResponseId = "native-echo-parent" };
    var outer = new AgentResponseUpdate(raw);
    if (mutation == "unknown") outer.RawRepresentation = new object();
    if (mutation == "contents") raw.Contents = [new FunctionCallContent("foreign", "backend", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["code"] = "foreign" })];
    if (mutation == "role") raw.Role = ChatRole.Tool;
    var rejected = false; AgentResponseUpdate? projected = null;

    try { projected = (AgentResponseUpdate?)publicBoundary.Invoke(null, [outer, new List<AIContent>()]); }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { rejected = true; }

    Check(mutation == "valid" ? !rejected && projected is null : rejected, "The actual all-owned-echo suppression boundary must validate raw data before dropping an empty projection: " + mutation);
}
var configureOptions = typeof(NativeSessionAgentFactory).Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeApprovalAgent")!.GetMethod("ConfigureOptions", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)!;
var backend = new ApprovalRequiredAIFunction(AIFunctionFactory.Create((string code) => code, "backend"));
var registeredCatalog = new NativeToolCatalog([new("backend", 1, backend.JsonSchema, RequiresConfirmation: true)]);
var originalBrowserSchema = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { type = "object", properties = new { city = new { type = "string" } }, required = new[] { "city" } });
var browserDeclaration = AIFunctionFactory.CreateDeclaration("frontend", "browser", originalBrowserSchema, null);
var originalInput = new RunAgentInput { ThreadId = "thread", RunId = "run", Messages = [], Tools = [new AGUITool { Name = "frontend", Description = "browser", Parameters = originalBrowserSchema }] };
foreach (var mutation in new[] { "valid", "unknown", "duplicate-browser", "duplicate-server", "browser-schema", "server-schema", "foreign-server-handler", "browser-handler" })
{
    var tools = new List<AITool> { backend, browserDeclaration };
    if (mutation == "unknown") tools.Add(AIFunctionFactory.CreateDeclaration("foreign", "foreign", originalBrowserSchema, null));
    if (mutation == "duplicate-browser") tools.Add(browserDeclaration);
    if (mutation == "duplicate-server") tools.Add(backend);
    if (mutation == "browser-schema") tools[1] = AIFunctionFactory.CreateDeclaration("frontend", "browser", JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { type = "object" }), null);
    if (mutation == "server-schema") tools[0] = AIFunctionFactory.CreateDeclaration("backend", "server", JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { type = "object" }), null);
    if (mutation == "foreign-server-handler") tools[0] = new ApprovalRequiredAIFunction(AIFunctionFactory.Create((string code) => "foreign", "backend"));
    if (mutation == "browser-handler") tools[1] = AIFunctionFactory.Create((string city) => "foreign", "frontend");
    var original = new ChatClientAgentRunOptions { ChatOptions = new ChatOptions { Tools = tools, Temperature = 0.25f, TopP = 0.8f, AdditionalProperties = new() { ["supported"] = true } }, AdditionalProperties = new() { ["request"] = "original" } };
    var before = JsonSerializer.Serialize(originalInput, AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput);
    var rejected = false; ChatClientAgentRunOptions? configured = null;

    try { configured = (ChatClientAgentRunOptions)configureOptions.Invoke(null, [original, originalInput, registeredCatalog, new[] { backend }])!; }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException or ArgumentException) { rejected = true; }

    Check(mutation == "valid" ? !rejected : rejected, "Preexisting native options may not introduce unregistered, duplicate, changed-schema, or foreign invocable tools: " + mutation);
    Check(JsonSerializer.Serialize(originalInput, AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput) == before && ReferenceEquals(original.ChatOptions.Tools, tools), "Original browser input and source options remain unchanged.");
    if (mutation == "valid")
    {
        var cloned = configured ?? throw new Exception("Expected cloned native run options.");
        var chat = cloned.ChatOptions ?? throw new Exception("Expected cloned chat options.");
        Check(!ReferenceEquals(cloned, original) && !ReferenceEquals(chat, original.ChatOptions) && chat.Temperature == original.ChatOptions.Temperature && chat.TopP == original.ChatOptions.TopP && chat.AdditionalProperties!["supported"] is true && cloned.AdditionalProperties!["request"] as string == "original", "Unrelated supported native/chat settings survive independent options cloning.");
        var declarations = chat.Tools!.OfType<AIFunctionDeclaration>().ToArray();
        Check(declarations.Length == 1 && declarations[0].Name == "frontend" && JsonNode.DeepEquals(JsonNode.Parse(declarations[0].JsonSchema.GetRawText()), JsonNode.Parse(originalBrowserSchema.GetRawText())), "Run options add exactly the original browser schema; registered server defaults participate once in the genuine native union.");
    }
}
var boundedJsonType = typeof(NativeSessionAgentFactory).Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeSessionJson");
Check(boundedJsonType is not null, "Actual native argument capture requires a bounded serialization boundary before JSON materialization.");
var boundedJson = boundedJsonType!.GetMethod("SerializeArguments", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)!;
var arguments = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["value"] = "é\"\\" };
var exactBytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(JsonSerializer.Serialize(arguments));

var boundedArguments = (JsonElement)boundedJson.Invoke(null, [arguments, exactBytes])!;
arguments["value"] = "changed";

Check(boundedArguments.GetProperty("value").GetString() == "é\"\\", "Bounded native arguments must be owned independently of source model objects.");
foreach (var (value, limit) in new[] { ((object)new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["value"] = "é\"\\" }, exactBytes - 1), ((object)new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["value"] = new string('x', 1000000) }, 128) })
{
    var rejected = false;

    try { boundedJson.Invoke(null, [value, limit]); }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is ArgumentException) { rejected = true; }

    Check(rejected, "Native argument serialization must reject exact UTF-8 overflow before materializing a complete JSON document.");
}
// Pure lower-layer Restore qualification: no journal acquisition, model or executor is called.
var restoreType = typeof(NativeSessionAgentFactory).Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeApprovalAgent")!;
var restore = restoreType.GetMethod("Restore", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static)!;
var registrationType = restoreType.Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeSessionRegistration")!;
var contextType = restoreType.Assembly.GetType("Hashbrown.AspNetCore.NativeSessionContext")!;
await using var mappingSource = Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSource.Create("Host=127.0.0.1;Port=1;Username=fixture;Database=fixture");
var mappingJournal = new PostgresNativeSessionJournal(mappingSource, registeredCatalog, "adapter", "adapter_native");
var registration = Activator.CreateInstance(registrationType, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null,
    ["native", mappingJournal, registeredCatalog, (Func<HttpContext, string?>)(_ => "owned"), new NativeSessionOptions()], null)!;
string MappingSnapshot(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(messages.Select(message => new { message.Role, message.MessageId, Contents = message.Contents.Select(content => new { Type = content.GetType().FullName, Json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(content, content.GetType()) }) }));
foreach (var scenario in new[] { "unknown-separate", "known-parent", "known-index", "different-parents", "repeated-parent-index", "reversed-parent-index", "repeated-known-index", "unknown-moved-calls" })
{
    NativeRequestLocation First() => scenario switch
    {
        "unknown-separate" or "unknown-moved-calls" => new(null, null, 0),
        "known-index" or "repeated-known-index" => new(null, 7, 0),
        "reversed-parent-index" => new("parent", null, 1),
        _ => new("parent", null, 0)
    };
    NativeRequestLocation Second() => scenario switch
    {
        "unknown-separate" or "unknown-moved-calls" => new(null, null, 0),
        "known-index" => new(null, 7, 1),
        "repeated-known-index" => new(null, 7, 0),
        "different-parents" => new("other-parent", null, 0),
        "repeated-parent-index" or "reversed-parent-index" => new("parent", null, 0),
        _ => new("parent", null, 1)
    };
    var descriptors = new[] {
        new NativeApprovalDescriptor("request-a", new("call-a", "backend", 1, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { code = "A" })), First()),
        new NativeApprovalDescriptor("request-b", new("call-b", "backend", 1, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { code = "B" })), Second())
    };
    var batch = new NativeBoundApprovalBatch(new("batch", descriptors, []), new Dictionary<string, NativePublicCallLocation> { ["request-a"] = new("assistant-call-a", 0, 0), ["request-b"] = new("assistant-call-b", 1, 0) });
    var ownedKey = new NativeSessionKey("native", "owned", "mapping", new Dictionary<string, string> { ["isolation"] = "owned" });
    var decisions = descriptors.Select(item => new NativeApprovalDecision(item.RequestId, NativeApprovalDecisionKind.Approved)).ToArray();
    var evidence = new NativeApprovalEvidence(ownedKey.Id, "adapter", registeredCatalog.Identity, new(ownedKey, "mapping-only", 2, 3), batch, 2, NativeApprovalState.DecisionAdmitted, decisions, 2, 3, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(1));
    var publicMessages = new JsonArray(descriptors.Select(item => (JsonNode?)new JsonObject { ["id"] = "assistant-" + item.Call.Id, ["role"] = "assistant", ["content"] = "", ["toolCalls"] = new JsonArray(new JsonObject { ["id"] = item.Call.Id, ["type"] = "function", ["function"] = new JsonObject { ["name"] = "backend", ["arguments"] = item.Call.Arguments.GetRawText() } }) }).ToArray());
    var raw = new JsonObject { ["threadId"] = "mapping", ["runId"] = "mapping", ["messages"] = publicMessages, ["tools"] = new JsonArray() }.ToJsonString();
    var input = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(raw, AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput)!;
    var context = Activator.CreateInstance(contextType, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, [registration, new DefaultHttpContext(), input, "owned", "owned", raw, null, null], null)!;
    contextType.GetProperty("ApprovalEvidence", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)!.SetValue(context, evidence);
    var converted = descriptors.Select(item => new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Assistant, [new FunctionCallContent(item.Call.Id, "backend", JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, object?>>(item.Call.Arguments))]) { MessageId = "assistant-" + item.Call.Id }).ToList();
    if (scenario == "unknown-moved-calls") converted.Reverse();
    converted.Add(new ChatMessage(ChatRole.User, decisions.Select(item => (AIContent)new InterruptResponseContent(item.RequestId) { Payload = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { approved = true }) }).ToList()));
    var before = MappingSnapshot(converted); var beforeLocations = JsonSerializer.Serialize(descriptors);
    var rejected = false; IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>? restored = null;

    try { restored = (IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>)restore.Invoke(null, [converted, context])!; }
    catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException is InvalidOperationException) { rejected = true; }

    var valid = scenario is "unknown-separate" or "known-parent" or "known-index" or "different-parents";
    Check(valid ? !rejected : rejected, "Restore distinguishes unknown separate native parents from proven same-group reversed/repeated positions and still rejects moved converted public calls: " + scenario);
    Check(MappingSnapshot(converted) == before && JsonSerializer.Serialize(descriptors) == beforeLocations, "Native Restore must not mutate public converted history or captured native locations: " + scenario);
    if (valid) Check(restored!.SelectMany(message => message.Contents).OfType<ToolApprovalRequestContent>().Select(item => ((FunctionCallContent)item.ToolCall).CallId).SequenceEqual(new[] { "call-a", "call-b" }), "Restoration replaces native approval requests in the original public sequence.");
    await ((IAsyncDisposable)context).DisposeAsync();
}

var unleasedAgent = NativeSessionAgentFactory.Create(new NeverModel(), "native", [backend], registeredCatalog, new HttpContextAccessor());
var unleasedCreateRejected = false;

try { await unleasedAgent.CreateSessionAsync(); }
catch (InvalidOperationException) { unleasedCreateRejected = true; }

Check(unleasedCreateRejected, "Actual native session creation must not bypass successful actual-key journal admission.");
Console.WriteLine("Native approval adapter projection passed.");

sealed class NeverModel : IChatClient
{
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new Exception("Preparation cannot invoke the model.");
    public IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => throw new Exception("Preparation cannot invoke the model.");
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}
